style.figure_intro: Studio product photo of ONE collectible designer vinyl toy for kids: a friendly chimera monster built as a ball-jointed action figure from six mismatched toy parts.
style.pose: Pose: standing upright on its two hind limbs like a small kaiju toy, body turned three-quarters to the left, face looking at the viewer, arms held slightly out from the sides, legs apart, relaxed neutral stance.
style.pose_quadruped_alt: Pose: standing on all four limbs like an animal, body in side three-quarter view facing left, head turned to the viewer, tail lifted, relaxed neutral stance.
style.tail_pose: , curving out behind the body, clearly visible and not touching the legs
style.extra_pose_single: , upright and clearly visible above the shoulders
style.material: Chunky rounded proportions, oversized head, short thick limbs, friendly expression, big simple eyes. Every body part is its own smooth molded plastic piece in its own colours; the pieces meet at clearly visible glossy off-white ball joints at the neck, shoulders, hips, tail base and back mount. Matte soft-touch vinyl with simple painted details, a few bold colours per piece. Fur, feathers and scales are sculpted as smooth stylised shapes, no loose hair.
style.framing: Soft even studio lighting from the front, faint soft contact shadow under the feet, seamless plain light-grey background, the whole figure centred in frame with empty margin on all sides, nothing cropped, sharp focus, no text.
style.card_intro: Studio product photo of ONE loose toy part from a build-a-figure set of collectible designer vinyl toys, shown alone:
style.card_material: Smooth molded matte soft-touch vinyl with simple painted details, chunky rounded kid-friendly shapes, fur, feathers and scales sculpted as smooth stylised forms.
style.card_framing: Three-quarter view, soft even studio lighting, faint soft contact shadow, seamless plain light-grey background, centred with empty margin on all sides, nothing cropped, sharp focus, no text.
